groups.comparison: Fresh NPZ1–69/pose272/outer_layer1–116/selfcollision283. NPZ optional size/missing-member checks are observations, names open archive keys not finite enum. Axis enum properly owns control dispatch; is_angle/is_identity derived predicates, continuous pose axes independent. Short GarmentPose panel list intentionally identity for remaining panels; Pivots own original frame/history and per-panel range+pivot products, no forced equality to posed state. OuterLayer correction Option complete displacement+normal; changed Bool immediate mutation outcome not retained mode. Pinned masses preserved, outer projection/readback failure ordering remains independent contract. SelfCollision has independent participation policy extendsF087; rebuild argument semantic action F119. Built history cannot be inferred from allocated buffers; no extra Ready flag or claim successful GPU execution. Radius/spacing dual storage and public mutation remain redundant-authority/invariant candidates with normal callers untraced. Normal SubstepHook always rebuilds; adjacency construction API trusts edge membership, no ordinary bad mesh alleged. NPZpost69/outerpost116 unread.
groups.disposition: F119 refresh action, F087 extended independent participation support; preserve valid pose/partial-list/history behavior
